The player's first night on F04. Mother Ilse welcomes them, the hall hums at dusk, and under the shrine one of the drifting lights says a word nobody alive can speak. Nothing is explained. The player should leave curious, not informed.

## Beat 1 — Dusk at the stair
at:: [[fates-shrine]]
with:: [[mother-ilse]]
says:: [[B-016]]
reveals:: [[C-031]]
when:: T1

The stair is crowded with candles. The hum rises as the light-strip dims, and the villagers stop talking until it settles.

## Beat 2 — Ilse's welcome
at::   [[fates-shrine]]
with::    [[mother-ilse]]
when:: T1

She greets the player as stair-child and tells them the lights are messengers. This beat says what she believes; her exact words compile from her lens.

## Beat 3 — The murmur

A light drifts down the cellar steps and stops in front of the player. When the hum falls, it says one word in a dead tongue, and the hum answers it from somewhere below, deep in the [[song-cellar]].

## Beat 5 - A synthetic heading without an em dash

Ilse keeps the vigil and tells the player why the hall must never fall silent.
